mapping_decisions.decision: All sixteen root meanings are retained. InputRefs preserve collection, identifier and selector in their separate namespace. Private scope operation anchors determine identity but are not added as public Scope members. Same anchors with different complete bodies retain distinct scopes/populations. Check identity includes its actual Result; Reason identity includes affected-result anchor links, so no cross-result reason union invents equivalent findings.

The finite case has22 planned jobs and78 atomic Results covering57 leaf names. M014 has eight independently anchored scopes: five canonical assurance queries, one PARENT graph query, one exact-Claim context and one Inquiry context. All24 context Results remain; an empty native inventory never erases its operation scope.

M008 and M011 have no actual represented role/route tuple. Their seven cells preserve the accepted structural no_applicable_subject explanation, null value and completed/not_applicable state. No grant is invented and no outside-world absence or independence follows. This fixed finite-job representation does not make every missing record structurally inapplicable.

Missing comparison membership stays unavailable, not a zero independent count. M009 missing externality assessment is unavailable while the explicitly examined stage-link inventory is available empty. M010 absent cohorts remain unestablished with null fractions/intervals; no empty numerical denominator or fabricated endpoint is introduced. Existing field-specific Reasons and checks are retained exactly.

M001 inventory witness members equal the complete corresponding Count Population.member_refs. That Population is the public home for every such member; no artificial Finding condition or second metric is created.

M003 comparison witness members are preserved by the four selected Populations. Its absent assessment is explicit in the Scope and missing-comparison Reason. Examined-assessment and selection source material is retained in actual PC03 InputRefs; this empty finite case has no hidden comparison witness to replace with a positive Finding.

Presence selected-members material is the union of its actual basis and transition basis; the three corresponding Scope/Population/Basis selections preserve Inquiry membership, and the existing qualification Findings retain selected_members components. Empty context owner material is preserved by the anomaly/contestation Basis union plus the exact context Population. Tail links retain their original M010 populations rather than donating a second stage cohort.

The empty correction-case witness preserves Inquiry and the four actual inquiry selection selectors through Basis and PC03 inputs. The empty human-review witness preserves its actual Inquiry and target_object_refs selection as one native-only corrective_independence_disclosures row retaining the exact InputRef selector and SelectedInquiry.target_object_refs. All original disclosure rows, including original support rows, precede examined-assessment rows in their original order, then actual source-reference slots in their original order; duplicate rows/slots are preserved. Scan rows carry the exact qualification Examined assessment only; this scan does not establish applicability or qualification for the selected review scope. Source rows carry Actual owner selection/source reference slot; this record does not establish an applicable review or independent process. No extra Basis entry, Check outcome, qualification or condition is invented. Its explicit empty Population remains separate and missing-comparison qualification. Their finite inventories are not findings of global non-change or no human judgment.

Existing supplied E1-to-O1 path proof is shown with the existing positive_witness/transformation_path_witness condition at each original origin/immediate owner Scope. Both ordered nodes and the exact PARENT edge are retained. Origin complete_trace has6 material slots and retains terminal O1; immediate complete_trace has5 and makes no terminal claim. Every trace array/observation remains in the same owner-scope Finding. No report-layer graph search, inferred new path or generic carrier condition is introduced. The narrower M014 query Finding remains independent.

Basis metadata comes from the source object original Provenance even when source.selector points to a binding field. Assertion scope/time/lifecycle and native Record/Inquiry time fields retain their names and unknown states. EvidenceReference availability/provider/attestor and scope_note remain attributable; excerpt and locator are not automatically copied. Basis check_refs link only actual PC05-PC10 checks of Results that use that precise BasisRef and whose input refers to the same source object; no global met check grants documentary qualification.

The origin-boundary, coverage and documentary-basis-gap disclosures explicitly normalize original selected source fields under fields.native_record; qualification_state and reason_codes remain separate derived fields. Actor display_name, Artifact work_key/locators and Claim text are not automatically exported. Method, native context, coverage state, source qualification and the supplied Unicode/backticks are retained. Original native ordered arrays keep their order.

The exact metadata qualifications and Capability scope_note in reference_document are fixed W02 engineering strings. Run timestamps are unknown with not_recorded_by_SIT-RP-0.1. In-process raw_file_digest is null; no canonical object hash is invented. Six fixed release-limit sentences are versioned tool statements.

JSON is compact J plus one LF. Markdown uses root-table order, complete pretty-J blocks, minimal safe backtick fences, each Result and its full Reason details, and the three unreduced available-fraction decimal lines. Reference bytes were authored from this independent logical document, never captured from a product renderer.
